roll_integrity_finding: The 1h continuous series contains close-to-open jumps up to 296 bps against a 0.2 bps median (1272x). The two largest sit on quarterly roll boundaries (2024-12-22, 2025-03-21) but others (2025-04-06/13/22) are news gaps. Roll-induced discontinuities are therefore NOT separable from genuine price gaps without contract identity. Approximately 10 quarterly rolls fall inside the 1h coverage window; none is documented.

reasons: 1-minute genuine NQ: 7 CME trade days (need multiple years)
the only multi-year intraday resolution is 1-hour (618 trade days), too coarse for microstructure and still continuous/unrolled
the only decade-length series is DAILY
no contract identity, no expiry, no roll log anywhere -> the required architecture (contract-level -> causal roll -> source contract retained) cannot be built from any existing file
back-adjustment status is unknown and unverifiable, so these prices must not be used for liquidity levels, VWAP, or any tick-exact quantity
